text.tspan: Five teammates. One explainable scientific research pipeline.
Like five detectives: find the books, sort them, choose the clues, check the claim, and show your working.
START: one scientific claim | public paper search | imported scientific records | your local text PDF
Combine the lists. Pick exact sentences
Does each clue agree, disagree, or tell
Keep both sides of a conflict
Show the exact clue. Let people check
AGGREGATED ANSWERS: SUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED / CONFLICTING / INSUFFICIENT. Processing failure is a separate state.
Cover one word; measure the class-score change. Green = toward
the target; red = away. Up to96 words; exact offsets + coverage.
Captum IG is experimental: failed numerical checks stay hidden.
Exact extracted text, page numbers and source SHA-256.
Text PDFs only; scanned/encrypted/empty files fail visibly.
A PDF link is not proof that full text was inspected.
Stage5 -> cached aggregation in Stage4 -> Stage5
No new NLI inference for paper-subset changes.
Save JSON -> validate claim / evidence / hashes -> replay.
Confidence and word scores are not scientific truth.
MEASURED RESULTS - different questions, never one pooled accuracy
1,024 questions;343 papers; one known source target
SciFact sentence micro-F1 (188 eligible dev claims)
28 truncated pairs excluded. Gold-cited full abstracts with
SUPPORT/CONTRADICT gold only; not end-to-end accuracy.
Top-rationale hit75% vs17.5%; only4 pairs from3 abstracts.
Exploratory gold-target study; not IG or general accuracy.
100 cached subset changes:0 new NLI calls; median1.14ms.
Local, preloaded-model observation; not a production SLA.
Recall@10: does a known relevant paper reach the first10? Ranking/evidence results are pinned owner experiments, not independently rerun in full by the frontend.
Qwen0.5B optional + gated; HF setup downloads
JSON + SHA-256 / local cache / background futures
No hosted model inference. Original claims and exact evidence preserved. Scientific/source review and actual five-person recording still require humans.
